headline: Argentine Government Allegedly Injects 2 Trillion Pesos to Cap Debt Yields
summary: Market analysts suspect an official body injected 2 trillion pesos into CER and Dual bonds at Wednesday's close to support prices and cap rising interest rates.
why: Central bank or official intervention in local debt markets aims to stabilize sovereign yields and manage domestic liquidity expectations.
why_moved: Substantial official intervention absorbs selling pressure and artificially limits yield expansion on local currency sovereign debt.
